body.message:
Dear Tharushi

Thank you for your offer and your support.

Due to our current financial situation, it is difficult for us to proceed at AED 5,200. We kindly request you to consider AED 5,000 as the final price.

If you agree to this rate, we are happy to confirm the extension and will plan to stay for the following month as well.

We appreciate your understanding and look forward to your kind consideration.

Thank you.
